hero.text: Online classes in English and English Literature conducted by R. C. Fernando. Clear explanation, guided practice, individual correction and steady revision — with extra support for learners who are finding it difficult.

blocks.heading: About RCF Online Academy
text: R. C. Fernando currently conducts mainly online classes through RCF Online Academy. These classes allow him to share the knowledge and practical experience developed over his long academic and professional career with learners regardless of their location.
Online delivery enables RCF Online Academy to reach students beyond a single geographical area and provide access to specialised English and literature instruction across the country.

He is a graduate in English of the University of Peradeniya, holds a Master of Arts in Linguistics from the University of Kelaniya and a TESOL qualification from the University of Peradeniya, and is an Associate Member of the Colombo Association of Language Skills and Dramatic Art (CALSDA). [His full background is here](about/background/).

blocks.heading: The teaching approach
intro: The same approach that runs through the lessons on this site. It is deliberately gradual, because most learners fail at writing and at literature answers through lack of preparation rather than lack of ability.

items.title: Clear and systematic explanation
text: One point at a time, in plain language, with the reason behind the rule and not only the rule.

items.title: Guided practice before independent work
text: No task is set cold. A model is studied, the structure is identified, and support is withdrawn step by step.

items.title: Practical use of language
text: English used for real purposes — writing a letter someone would actually send, saying something you would actually say.

items.title: Individual correction and feedback
text: Written work is corrected individually, with one clear instruction rather than a page of red.

items.title: Examination preparation where relevant
text: Paper structure, timing, answer development and past-paper practice, for those preparing for O/L or A/L.

items.title: Regular revision
text: Deliberate return to earlier work, spaced out, because that is what makes learning permanent.

items.title: Confidence, and support for those in difficulty
text: Extra help for learners who are struggling, without singling them out in front of others.

items.title: O/L candidates
text: Grade 10 and 11 students preparing for English and English Literature, including private candidates studying without a school.

items.title: A/L Literature students
text: Advanced Level students who need close reading, critical appreciation and well-organised essay answers.

items.title: Adult learners
text: Adults returning to English for work or daily life, and anyone rebuilding confidence after a long gap.

items.title: Learners who hesitate to speak
text: People who understand English perfectly well but cannot bring themselves to use it.

items.title: Students who need extra help
text: Learners who need smaller steps, more models and more repetition — including in one-to-one classes.

items.title: Students in rural and remote areas
text: Online delivery means that specialised English and Literature teaching is not limited to one town.

items.title: Individual Classes
text: One-to-one teaching arranged around a single learner's needs and pace.

items.title: Group Classes
text: Small-group teaching, where learners benefit from other people's questions.

items.q: How do I join a class?
a: Choose a class, contact RCF Online Academy on WhatsApp, and you will be sent the schedule, fee and availability information. Registration is confirmed by the teacher; it is not automatic and nothing on this website enrols you.

items.q: Why are the days, times and fees not shown for every class?
a: Because they change, and publishing an out-of-date schedule helps nobody. Where a detail has not been settled, this site says so rather than inventing a figure. Ask on WhatsApp and you will be told what currently applies.

items.q: Are the classes online or in a classroom?
a: Classes are conducted mainly online, which allows students in any part of the country to attend.

items.q: What do I need in order to attend?
a: A device with an internet connection, a notebook and a pen. Spoken English classes also need a working microphone. Literature classes need the prescribed texts.

items.q: Are classes in English only?
a: Classes are conducted in English, with explanation in simpler language where a learner needs it. Nobody is expected to understand everything immediately.

items.q: Can I join in the middle of a course?
a: It depends on the course and how far it has progressed. Ask on WhatsApp and you will be told honestly whether joining now would work for you.

items.q: Is there individual attention in a group class?
a: Written work is corrected individually in both group and individual classes. Learners who need more support than a group allows are usually better suited to individual classes.

items.q: Do you teach students who are very weak in English?
a: Yes. Support for learners experiencing difficulty is a particular emphasis of these classes, and of this whole platform.

items.q: Will I be sent a meeting link?
a: Joining instructions are sent privately once your place is confirmed. Meeting links and passwords are never published on this website.

items.q: Can I register on this website?
a: No. This website has no server and no registration system. Enrolment is arranged directly with the teacher on WhatsApp, and a place is confirmed only by the teacher.

items.q: Is any payment taken on this website?
a: No. RCF English does not take payments of any kind, and no payment details should ever be entered anywhere on this site. Fee arrangements are discussed directly.

items.q: How soon will I get a reply?
a: Messages are answered as soon as possible. If you have not heard within a couple of days, please send a reminder — messages are occasionally missed.

items.q: What if the class times do not suit me?
a: Say so. Times are sometimes arranged around the students who want a particular class, especially for individual classes.

items.q: Can I try a class before deciding?
a: Ask. Whether this is possible depends on the course and where it has reached, and you will be told honestly.

items.q: Can my parent make the enquiry for me?
a: Of course. Please say who the student is, their grade, and what they need.

blocks.title: Please note
bullets: **Nothing on this website constitutes an offer of a place.** Class information here is descriptive.
**Do not send personal documents, identity numbers or payment details** in an enquiry message.
**Joining links and passwords are never published here** and are sent privately after confirmation.

pages.title: Frequently Asked Questions
pages.description: Answers to common questions about RCF Online Academy: joining, schedules and fees, what is needed, how classes are taught and what support is available.
pages.keywords: RCF Online Academy FAQ, questions, joining, fees, schedule

hero.text: If your question is not answered here, ask on WhatsApp — the answer is usually quicker than the search.

items.q: How do I join?
a: Choose a class, contact RCF Online Academy on WhatsApp, and you will be sent the schedule, fee and availability information. Registration is confirmed by the teacher; it is not automatic. See [Enrolment](rcf-classes/enrolment/).

items.q: Can I register on this website?
a: No. This website has no server and no registration system. Nothing here reserves a place.

items.q: Is any payment taken on this website?
a: No. RCF English does not take payments of any kind. Never enter payment details anywhere on this site.

items.q: Can I join in the middle of a course?
a: It depends on the course and how far it has gone. Ask, and you will be told honestly whether joining now would work for you.

items.q: Can my parent enquire for me?
a: Yes. Please say who the student is, their grade, and what they need help with.

items.q: Why are the days and times not shown for every class?
a: Because they change, and an out-of-date timetable helps nobody. Times are also sometimes arranged around the students who want a particular class. Where nothing has been settled, this site says so rather than inventing a schedule.

items.q: Why are the fees not published?
a: Fees depend on the course, its length and its format, and they change. They are given directly, so that what you are told is what actually applies.

items.q: How long is a class?
a: It depends on the course. This is confirmed when you enquire, along with the day and time.

items.q: What if the times do not suit me?
a: Say so when you enquire. Alternative arrangements are sometimes possible, particularly for individual classes.

items.q: Are the classes online or in a classroom?
a: Classes are conducted mainly online, which allows students anywhere in the country to attend.

items.q: What do I need in order to attend?
a: A device with an internet connection, a notebook and a pen. Spoken English classes also need a working microphone. Literature classes need the prescribed texts.

items.q: What if my internet connection is weak?
a: Mention it when you enquire. It is a common situation and it is better discussed in advance than discovered in the first class.

items.q: Are classes conducted in English?
a: Yes, with explanation in simpler language where a learner needs it. Nobody is expected to understand everything immediately, and nobody is made to feel foolish for asking.

items.q: Is written work corrected?
a: Yes. Individual correction and feedback is one of the emphases of these classes, in both group and individual formats.

items.q: Is there individual attention in a group class?
a: Written work is corrected individually in both formats. A learner who needs more support than a group allows is usually better suited to individual classes.

items.q: Will I be sent a meeting link?
a: Joining instructions are sent privately once your place is confirmed. Links and passwords are never published on this website.

items.q: Do you teach students who are very weak in English?
a: Yes. Additional support for learners experiencing difficulty is a particular emphasis of these classes and of this whole platform. Learners are not moved on before a step is secure.

items.q: I understand English but I cannot speak it. Can that be helped?
a: Yes, and it is very common. Spoken English classes are built around exactly this: practice in real situations, with correction, in a setting where mistakes are expected rather than punished.

items.q: Can examination results be guaranteed?
a: No, and nobody honest will guarantee them. Results depend on the student's own work. What the classes provide is clear teaching, guided practice, individual correction and regular revision.

items.q: Are these classes connected to any school or government body?
a: No. RCF Online Academy is an independent teaching programme and makes no claim of official approval or affiliation.

items.q: Are the free resources on this site only for class students?
a: No. Everything on RCF English is free and open to everyone, whether or not you attend a class.
